lede: A PPO-trained network that trades BTC/USD. The day-trading versions use 15-minute bars, start every UTC day flat and close out by midnight. The swing version uses 4-hour bars and can hold a position for up to 30 days. Every version sees only completed bars, pays realistic costs on every trade, and is scored one untouched year at a time from 2021 to 2026 against simple baselines. Switch the market model and the network at the top. Every chart below updates.
limits: No version made money after costs. Spot PPO averaged -0.15% a day, with a 95% interval entirely below zero. It beat intraday buy and hold only by holding less, and it did no better than a random policy trading at the same rate.

There is a small, real signal. A plain linear forecast ranks the next 15-minute return with a rank IC of about 0.01 to 0.05 out of sample. At a typical 0.3% bar move, that is worth roughly 0.01% per trade, while a round trip costs 0.12% (perp) to 0.40% (spot). With zero costs, the same frozen spot ensemble is positive in 5 of 6 test years. The limit is cost per trade relative to edge, not network capacity.

The only strategy with an interval above zero is the perp linear forecast: +0.031% a day, trading 0.17 times a day. It was one of several baselines and the interval barely clears zero, so treat it as a lead to pre-register, not a result.

Longer holds (the swing version) removed most of the cost drag but did not create an edge. Spot swing PPO averaged -0.001% a day, trailing buy and hold by 0.03% a day (interval -0.07 to +0.01). It was in the market 78% of the time, so it mostly rode BTC's moves. Its long preference has a rank IC near zero against the next 4-hour bar. Perp swing lost 0.087% a day. Every trend and reversion rule tested also trailed buy and hold.
Perp results use Bitstamp spot prices, a flat 0.01% funding charge and fixed slippage. Real perp basis, funding swings and queue position are not modeled.
Fills are at the next bar's open plus fixed slippage. Spread widening in fast markets, partial fills and exchange outages beyond the excluded days are not modeled.

The deep network was added after the compact results were seen, at Soren's request, as a capacity test. Its settings were fixed before its test years were scored, but it is a second look at the same years.
Data is a single venue (Bitstamp) through a public mirror. 69 days with gaps or outages were dropped, and some of those were volatile days.
Paper research only. Nothing here sends orders.
